name: The Courtyard House
headline:
Old soul.
New beginnings.
intro: Quiet courtyards, warm textures, and a city full of stories just beyond your door. A thoughtfully restored home in the heart of Sibiu.
storyTitle:
A home with
something to say.
story: Behind a modest street entrance, a private courtyard opens onto a home full of warmth. Original details sit comfortably alongside a fresh, thoughtful renovation.
Three bedrooms and generous shared spaces make room for friends and family, while the sheltered courtyard offers a peaceful place to begin and end each day.

images.alt: Inviting neutral living room in a thoughtfully restored house
images.caption: A new chapter, beautifully lived.

images.alt: Restored home interior with warm finishes
images.caption: Small details. Lasting character.

locationDescription: Walk to a morning market, linger in the old town, and find a new favourite café. This peaceful pocket of Sibiu puts daily life within easy reach.
